reasoning_layers.DETERMINISTIC RULES: tajwīd rule location (app/tajweed_rules/parser.py), the phonetiser (quran-transcript), rule binding, scoring against bands, session scoring
reasoning_layers.SIGNAL PROCESSING: decoding (ffmpeg), pause/stop detection from the waveform (app/waqf.py), audio cleaning (letter corpus), Praat formants and Octave features (pipeline / research), WORLD and phase-vocoder edits (synthesis lab)
reasoning_layers.STATISTICAL MODELS: count-unit scaling, master reference quantiles and robust z (reference_stats.json), logistic blind-spot model (blindspots.json), stretch calculus (stretch_model.json), calibration bands (pipeline, calibration.json); fitted offline in Julia
reasoning_layers.ML MODELS: muaalem v3.2 posteriors (the Sessions engine), wav2vec2 aligner and ECAPA (pipeline), Whisper (verse detection)
reasoning_layers.LLMs / AGENTS: none in the engine or the web app (no LLM API client in app/ or datastore/). The code was written with an AI coding agent; that is development, not runtime.
reasoning_layers.NEURAL AUDIO MODELS: Matcha-TTS + BigVGAN pilot (experimental, Modal), edge-tts (external service, probe)

measures.algorithm: CTC likelihood of the reference vs the same context with the letter replaced by each classical confusion or deleted; margin = -max log-ratio (nats); confirmed when every alternative loses
measures.features: muaalem phoneme posteriors over the letter +/- 2 units, 3 frames margin
measures.uncertainty: margin; blind_spot_p (context model from 41 T300 reciters); scored=false when p >= 0.25
measures.evidence: sessions: ḍād->dāl, ṭāʾ->tāʾ voiced cases caught in round 5; sākin ṭāʾ->tāʾ missed; QuranMB v2 learner letter substitutions: recall 0.562 at 1.33 reports per clean clip (learner_eval/results/head_to_head.json)

measures.algorithm: identity test above against classical confusions (18 letters have one); a neighbour test against letters at adjacent points (all 28) -- reported only, on by default for drill text
measures.evidence: no validation of the neighbour test on labelled data; whole-syllable splices flip it (synthesis lab)

measures.algorithm: expected class (from the phonetiser) vs the head's posterior over the letter's frames; margin = log p(expected) - log p(best other)
measures.uncertainty: margin, percentile vs masters, blind_spot_p; takrīr never scored; shiddah on doubled letters and istiṭālah off ض not scored
measures.evidence: synthesis lab (research_agency_lab/experiments/synthesis/world_lab_*.json): physically devoicing ز د ج ع ب غ to 0-6 % voiced did not flip hams/jahr; the heads track letter identity more than the acoustics

measures.algorithm: identity test of each short vowel against the other two; itmām (full vowel articulation) measured descriptively, not scored
measures.evidence: a dropped ḍammah (كُفُوًا, round 2) was missed; ishbāʿ is not scored (itmam.py is descriptive)

measures.algorithm: units' frame spans (40 ms); count unit per ayah = median of vowelled-letter spans; counts through a fitted scale
measures.uncertainty: 40 ms resolution; the last unit of a clip is not measured (unreliable tail); implausible values (>12 counts) dropped

measures.algorithm: located from text; measured counts vs nominal band ± tolerance; munfaṣil / ṣilah kubrā judged against a declared or inferred wajh (qaṣr 2 / tawassuṭ 4-5); stretch calculus against masters at the reader's tempo
measures.evidence: sessions: muttaṣil and ṣilah kubrā cut to 2 counts caught; madd ʿiwaḍ at a stop not measurable

measures.algorithm: held length of the nasal units vs [2.0, masters' 95th percentile] counts; grades (akmal/kāmilah/nāqiṣah/anqaṣ) reported with textbook bands, not scored
measures.evidence: as recorded: ghunnah dropped at إِنَّ missed (r1e1); shaddah ghunnah cut in جَآنٌّ flagged for another reason (r1e2); merges without ghunnah caught (r4e1, r4e2, r5e1, r5e3); ghunnah ADDED to idghām without ghunnah not caught (r2e3 flagged for another reason, r5e2 missed)

sessions.scope: rounds 1-5 (round 6 is a letter-drill experiment, excluded)

exercises.title: The madd ladder — al-Mutaffifin 83:32
exercises.goal: Five lengths in six words: tabii 2, munfasil 4 (declared tawassut), muttasil 4, lazim 6, plus the shaddah ghunnah of inna. Does the engine measure each length on your count unit, and does it catch each one cut short -- including a munfasil it used to excuse as qasr?
exercises.spec: Tadwir, one breath, stop at the end. Hold: وَإِذَا 2 · قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّ munfasil 4 · the ghunnah of إِنَّ 2 · both madds of هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ 4 · لَضَآلُّونَ the lazim 6.

expect.note: judged by the stretch calculus at your tempo

mistakes.do: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّ — munfasil at 2 counts (qasr), though you declared 4.
إِنَّ — drop the ghunnah: a short plain nūn, no nasal hold.
هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ — both madds at 2 counts.
لَضَآلُّونَ — the lazim at 2 counts instead of 6.

exercises.title: The ghunnah family — ar-Rahman 55:39
exercises.goal: Ikhfa twice, iqlab, idgham with ghunnah and the shaddah ghunnah, next to a ṣila kubrā and a 6-count lazim. The hardest family in the profiles (idgham with ghunnah passed 0.69, ghunnah 0.76, ikhfa 0.80 across 41 masters): which of these does the engine actually hear, and which can it not?
exercises.spec: Tadwir, stop at the end. Ghunnah 2 counts on every nasal: عَن ذَنۢبِهِۦٓ (ikhfa), ذَنۢبِهِۦٓ (iqlab: meem), إِنسٌ (ikhfa), إِنسٌ وَلَا (idgham with ghunnah), جَآنٌّ (shaddah). ذَنۢبِهِۦٓ إِنسٌ ṣila kubrā 4 · جَآنٌّ lazim 6.

expect.note: judged by the stretch calculus at your tempo

mistakes.do: عَن ذَنۢبِهِۦٓ — iẓhār: a clear nūn, tongue on the gum, no hiding, no nasal hold.
ذَنۢبِهِۦٓ — no iqlab: a clear nūn before the bā', no meem.
إِنسٌ وَلَا — iẓhār of the tanwīn: 'insun walā', the nūn clear, no merging.
جَآنٌّ — keep the 6-count madd, but cut the shaddah ghunnah to a short plain nūn.

exercises.title: Characteristics and articulation — at-Tariq 86:1–3
exercises.goal: Qalqalah at three stops, heavy against light (ṭā' / tā', ṣād / sīn), the ra' light under kasrah, and thā' against sīn -- across three ayahs, so the tempo and the madd lengths must also hold steady from ayah to ayah.
exercises.spec: Tadwir, stop at the end of each ayah with a clear qalqalah on the qāf and the bā'. ٱلسَّمَآءِ muttasil 4 · وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ munfasil 4 · ٱلطَّارِقِ the rā' light (kasrah).

mistakes.do: وَٱلطَّارِقِ — stop dead on the qāf: no echo, no qalqalah.
وَٱلسَّمَآءِ — make the sīn heavy, like ṣād.
ٱلطَّارِقُ — make the ṭā' light, like tā'.
ٱلثَّاقِبُ — say the thā' as sīn.

exercises.title: Articulation points beginners confuse — al-Fatihah 1:5–7
exercises.goal: The five classic substitutions of non-Arabic learners, one per word: ʿayn as hamza, ṣād as sīn, qāf as kāf, ḍād as dāl, ḍād as ẓā'. Al-Fatihah is half of all learner recordings in the open datasets. Which substitutions does the articulation test (each letter against its nearest-articulation competitor) decide, and by what margin?
exercises.spec: Tadwir, stop at the end of each ayah. ٱلضَّآلِّينَ lazim 6; the ʿāriḍ at نَسْتَعِينُ and ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمَ 4.

expect.note: judged by the stretch calculus at your tempo

mistakes.do: نَعْبُدُ — say the ʿayn as a hamza: 'na-abudu'.
ٱلصِّرَٰطَ — say the ṣād as sīn: 'as-sirāt'.
ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمَ — say the qāf as kāf: 'al-mustakīm'.
ٱلْمَغْضُوبِ — say the ḍād as dāl: 'al-maghdūb'.
ٱلضَّآلِّينَ — keep the 6-count madd, but say the ḍād as ẓā': 'aẓ-ẓāllīn'.

exercises.title: Qalqalah at the stop, the rā', and ikhfā' — al-Falaq 113:1–3
exercises.goal: Round 1 missed a qalqalah dropped at a stop (its margin barely moved). Is that systematic? Two more stops, on qāf and bā'. Plus the rā' made light where it must be heavy, khā' as ḥā', and ikhfā' read as a clear nūn in a new context.
exercises.spec: Tadwir, stop at the end of each ayah with a clear qalqalah. بِرَبِّ the rā' heavy · شَرِّ the rā' light (kasrah) · مِن شَرِّ and وَمِن شَرِّ ikhfā' with ghunnah.

mistakes.do: بِرَبِّ — make the rā' light (it carries fatḥah and must be heavy).
ٱلْفَلَقِ — stop dead on the qāf: no echo.
مِن شَرِّ — iẓhār: a clear nūn before the shīn, no nasal hold.
خَلَقَ — say the khā' as ḥā': 'ḥalaq'.
وَقَبَ — stop dead on the bā': no echo.

exercises.title: The Name, qalqalah ṣughrā and kubrā, idghām, a vowel — al-Ikhlāṣ 112:1–4
exercises.goal: The surah of the largest labelled learner dataset (1,506 clips, nearly all errors qalqalah of the dāl). The lām of the Name heavy after ḍammah, qalqalah on a sākin dāl mid-ayah (ṣughrā) and at a stop (kubrā), idghām without ghunnah read with one, and a dropped vowel.
exercises.spec: Tadwir, stop at the end of each ayah. ٱللَّهُ heavy in both ayahs · يَلِدْ qalqalah ṣughrā (no stop) · ٱلصَّمَدُ, يُولَدْ, أَحَدٌۢ qalqalah at the stop · يَكُن لَّهُۥ idghām without ghunnah.

mistakes.do: ٱللَّهُ (ayah 1) — make the lām of the Name light, though it follows a ḍammah.
ٱلصَّمَدُ — stop on the dāl with no qalqalah.
يَلِدْ — no qalqalah on the sākin dāl (keep going into وَلَمْ).
يَكُن لَّهُۥ — merge the nūn into the lām WITH a nasal ghunnah (it must be without).
كُفُوًا — drop the ḍammah on the fā': 'kufwan'.

exercises.title: One passage at two speeds — al-ʿAṣr 103:1–3
exercises.goal: Both takes perfect: take A at your tadwīr, take B clearly faster while keeping every rule and characteristic intact. The adaptive timing judges each stretching against your own count at each speed; a fast correct reading must score exactly as well as a measured one, and every stretching should keep its proportion.
exercises.spec: Tadwīr, stop at the end of each ayah. إِنَّ ghunnah · ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ ikhfā' · ءَامَنُوا۟ badal · بِٱلصَّبْرِ qalqalah at the stop.

exercises.title: Light letters made heavy — al-Masad 111:1–3
exercises.goal: Rounds 1–2 caught ṣād→sīn, ḍād→ẓā', qāf→kāf and khā'→ḥā', but missed sīn→ṣād, ṭā'→tā' and ḍād→dāl -- the pairs that share a makhraj and differ only in itbāq and tafkhīm. This round tests the other direction (tā'→ṭā', dāl→ḍād) and sīn→ṣād again in a new word, with ṣād→sīn (caught before) in the same take as the reference point.
exercises.spec: Tadwīr, stop at the end of each ayah. يَدَآ أَبِى and مَآ أَغْنَىٰ munfasil 4 · لَهَبٍۢ وَتَبَّ idghām with ghunnah · نَارًۭا ذَاتَ ikhfā' · qalqalah at the stops on وَتَبَّ, كَسَبَ, لَهَبٍۢ.

mistakes.do: تَبَّتْ — say the first tā' as ṭā': 'ṭabbat'.
يَدَآ — say the dāl as ḍād: 'yaḍā' (keep the munfasil at 4).
كَسَبَ — say the sīn as ṣād: 'kaṣab'.
سَيَصْلَىٰ — say the ṣād as sīn: 'sayaslā' (the direction caught before).

exercises.title: The nasal family in context — az-Zalzalah 99:7–8
exercises.goal: Idghām with ghunnah three times, iẓhār ḥalqī and ikhfā' on tanwīn, and heavy rā's. The blind-spot graph finds the hidden nūn unreliable before ف ق ك س ت; before shīn it is trusted, so this is a clean test of whether an iẓhār of ikhfā' is heard -- and whether a merge without ghunnah is.
exercises.spec: Tadwīr, stop at the end of each ayah (يَرَهْ). فَمَن يَعْمَلْ and وَمَن يَعْمَلْ idghām with ghunnah 2 · ذَرَّةٍ خَيْرًۭا iẓhār · خَيْرًۭا يَرَهُۥ and شَرًّۭا يَرَهُۥ idghām with ghunnah · ذَرَّةٍۢ شَرًّۭا ikhfā' · every rā' heavy.

mistakes.do: فَمَن يَعْمَلْ — merge the nūn into the yā' with NO ghunnah: a plain 'fa-may-yaʿmal'.
خَيْرًۭا يَرَهُۥ — iẓhār of the tanwīn: 'khayran yarah', the nūn clear, no merging.
ذَرَّةٍۢ شَرًّۭا — iẓhār of the tanwīn before shīn: 'dharratin sharran', a clear nūn.
شَرًّۭا — make the rā' light (it carries fatḥah and must be heavy).

exercises.title: Vowels: wrong, dropped, stretched — al-Kawthar 108:1–3
exercises.goal: Round 2's dropped ḍammah (كُفُوًا) went unseen: short vowels are tested only against each other, and a missing vowel has no competitor. This round separates four vowel errors -- a wrong vowel (has a competitor), a dropped vowel, a short vowel stretched into a madd, and a natural madd cut to one count.
exercises.spec: Tadwīr, stop at the end of each ayah. إِنَّآ ghunnah and munfasil 4 · أَعْطَيْنَـٰكَ and شَانِئَكَ madd 2 · فَصَلِّ heavy ṣād · وَٱنْحَرْ and ٱلْأَبْتَرُ heavy rā' at the stop · ٱلْأَبْتَرُ qalqalah on the bā'.

mistakes.do: أَعْطَيْنَـٰكَ — cut the madd on the nūn to one count: 'aʿṭaynaka'.
فَصَلِّ — end on fatḥah instead of kasrah: 'fa-ṣalla'.
شَانِئَكَ — drop the kasrah of the nūn: 'shān'aka'.
هُوَ — stretch the ḍammah into a madd: 'hūwa'.

exercises.title: One long ayah — Yūnus 10:12
exercises.goal: Real learners read long ayahs. The knowledge graph chose this one from the long surahs (18–40 words) for coverage: 11 of the 12 rule kinds we target in 27 words, with three ḍāds, two sīns and a dāl. Does the engine hold alignment, tempo and every judgement over a long ayah, and do the substitutions tested in the short ones behave the same here?
exercises.spec: Tadwīr, in three breaths with the two stops marked in the text: stop on قَآئِمَا (madd 'iwaḍ, two counts) and resume with فَلَمَّا; stop on مَسَّهْ (at the ۚ) and resume with كَذَٰلِكَ; stop at the end. ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ ikhfā' · ٱلضُّرُّ heavy ḍād · لِجَنۢبِهِۦٓ iqlāb and ṣila kubrā 4 · قَآئِمًۭا muttaṣil 4 · فَلَمَّا ghunnah · كَأَن لَّمْ idghām without ghunnah · يَدْعُنَآ إِلَىٰ munfaṣil 4 and qalqalah on the dāl · ضُرٍّۢ مَّسَّهُۥ idghām with ghunnah · ٱلْمُسْرِفِينَ light rā'.

mistakes.do: مَسَّ — say the sīn as ṣād: 'maṣṣa'.
دَعَانَا — say the dāl as ḍād: 'ḍaʿānā'.
ضُرَّهُۥ — say the ḍād as dāl: 'durrahu'.
ضُرٍّۢ مَّسَّهُۥ — merge the tanwīn into the mīm with NO ghunnah.
ٱلْمُسْرِفِينَ — make the rā' heavy (it carries kasrah and must be light).

exercises.title: Idghām with ghunnah, re-measured — al-Mulk 67:22
exercises.goal: Round 3 found the engine timing the vowel AFTER a merged yā' instead of the held yā', so correct idghāms read 'short' and a merge without ghunnah passed. Now it times the held letter (Husary: 2.2-3.8 counts) against the ghunnah band. The knowledge graph chose this ayah: two idghāms into yā' (أَفَمَن يَمْشِى, أَمَّن يَمْشِى), one into mīm (صِرَٰطٍۢ مُّسْتَقِيمٍۢ) and a mushaddad ghunnah, in 12 words. Take B also tests shīn made sīn, a letter not tested yet.
exercises.spec: Tadwīr, one breath, stop at the end (مُّسْتَقِيمْ). أَفَمَن يَمْشِى, أَمَّن يَمْشِى and صِرَٰطٍۢ مُّسْتَقِيمٍۢ idghām with ghunnah · أَمَّن ghunnah on the mīm · وَجْهِهِۦٓ أَهْدَىٰٓ ṣila kubrā 4 and qalqalah on the jīm · أَهْدَىٰٓ أَمَّن munfaṣil 4 · مُكِبًّا عَلَىٰ and سَوِيًّا عَلَىٰ iẓhār.

mistakes.do: أَفَمَن يَمْشِى — merge the nūn into the yā' with NO ghunnah: 'afamay-yamshī'.
يَمْشِى — say the shīn as sīn: 'yamsī'.
أَمَّن يَمْشِى — iẓhār: 'amman yamshī', the nūn clear, no merging (keep the ghunnah on the mīm).
صِرَٰطٍۢ مُّسْتَقِيمٍۢ — merge the tanwīn into the mīm with NO ghunnah.

exercises.title: A long ayah with its stops named — Āyat al-Kursī 2:255
exercises.goal: The first long ayah recited the way a learner recites it: in breaths, stopping where the text allows. The stops are declared, so the engine expects the waqf form at each (a madd ʿāriḍ, no ṣila) and nothing is left to the reciter's choice. Fifty words, eleven rule kinds, a nūn merged with and without ghunnah, and ḥā', ʿayn and ẓā' in take B.
exercises.spec: Tadwīr, six breaths, stopping ONLY at the five marked stops: ٱلْقَيُّومْ · ٱلْأَرْضْ · خَلْفَهُمْ · شَآءْ · حِفْظُهُمَا · and the end, ٱلْعَظِيمْ. Read through نَوْمٌۭ لَّهُۥ (idghām without ghunnah) and بِإِذْنِهِۦ يَعْلَمُ (ṣila) without stopping. لَآ إِلَـٰهَ munfaṣil 4 · سِنَةٌۭ وَلَا and بِشَىْءٍۢ مِّنْ idghām with ghunnah · مَن ذَا and عِندَهُۥٓ ikhfā' · عِندَهُۥٓ إِلَّا and عِلْمِهِۦٓ إِلَّا ṣila kubrā 4 · تَأْخُذُهُۥ, لَّهُۥ, بِإِذْنِهِۦ, يَـُٔودُهُۥ ṣila ṣughrā 2 · مِّنْ عِلْمِهِۦٓ iẓhār.

mistakes.do: ٱلْحَىُّ — say the ḥā' as hā': 'al-hayy'.
سِنَةٌۭ وَلَا — merge the tanwīn into the wāw with NO ghunnah: 'sinatuw-wa lā'.
يَشْفَعُ — say the ʿayn as a hamza: 'yashfaʾu'.
بِشَىْءٍۢ مِّنْ — iẓhār: 'bishayʾin min', the nūn clear, no merging.
ٱلْعَظِيمْ — say the ẓā' as zāy: 'al-ʿazīm'.

exercises.title: The mīm family and two misses retested — al-Fīl 105:1–5
exercises.goal: No take B has tested mīm sākinah yet: iẓhār shafawī four times, ikhfāʾ shafawī at تَرْمِيهِم بِحِجَارَةٍۢ, beside two idghāms with ghunnah. Two substitutions missed in rounds 1–2 come back in new words: ḍād as dāl (تَضْلِيلٍۢ, missed in ٱلْمَغْضُوبِ) and ṭāʾ as tāʾ (طَيْرًا, missed in ٱلطَّارِقُ).
exercises.spec: Tadwīr, stop at the end of each ayah. تَرْمِيهِم بِحِجَارَةٍۢ ikhfāʾ shafawī with ghunnah 2 · بِحِجَارَةٍۢ مِّن and كَعَصْفٍۢ مَّأْكُولٍۭ idghām with ghunnah · مِّن سِجِّيلٍۢ ikhfāʾ · every mīm before a letter other than bāʾ or mīm clear (iẓhār shafawī) · طَيْرًا ṭāʾ and rāʾ heavy.

mistakes.do: تَضْلِيلٍۢ — say the ḍād as dāl: 'taḍlīl' becomes 'tadlīl'.
طَيْرًا — make the ṭāʾ light, like tāʾ: 'tayran' (keep the rāʾ heavy).
تَرْمِيهِم بِحِجَارَةٍۢ — iẓhār shafawī: close the lips on a clear mīm, no hiding, no nasal hold before the bāʾ.
كَعَصْفٍۢ مَّأْكُولٍۭ — merge the tanwīn into the mīm with NO ghunnah.

exercises.title: Idghām without ghunnah against with — al-Balad 90:5–7
exercises.goal: Round 4 caught every merge made without ghunnah, but at 1.81–1.92 counts against a band that starts at 2.0: a thin margin. Here three idghāms WITHOUT ghunnah (أَن لَّن, مَالًۭا لُّبَدًا, أَن لَّمْ) sit beside one WITH (لَّن يَقْدِرَ). Round 2 missed the reverse error — a ghunnah added where it must not be (يَكُن لَّهُۥ).
exercises.spec: Tadwīr, stop at the end of each ayah. أَن لَّن, مَالًۭا لُّبَدًا and أَن لَّمْ idghām WITHOUT ghunnah, no nasal hold · لَّن يَقْدِرَ idghām with ghunnah 2 · يَرَهُۥٓ أَحَدٌ ṣila kubrā 4 · qalqalah on يَقْدِرَ and at the stops on أَحَدٌۭ and أَحَدٌ · لُّبَدًا madd ʿiwaḍ 2 at the stop.

mistakes.do: أَن لَّن — merge the nūn into the lām WITH a nasal ghunnah (it must be without).
لَّن يَقْدِرَ — merge the nūn into the yāʾ with NO ghunnah.
مَالًۭا لُّبَدًا — iẓhār of the tanwīn: 'mālan lubadā', the nūn clear, no merging.
يَرَهُۥٓ أَحَدٌ — the ṣila kubrā at 2 counts instead of 4.

exercises.title: Madd too short, the shafawī idghām, qalqalah at the stop — al-Qadr 97:1–5
exercises.goal: 'Madd too short' is still on caution (0.937 against 0.95), so a muttaṣil is cut to two counts. Idghām shafawī (رَبِّهِم مِّن) is read without its ghunnah, an iẓhār ḥalqī (مِّنْ أَلْفِ) is hidden, and a qalqalah is dropped at a stop on dāl. A third ṭāʾ→tāʾ, sākinah this time (مَطْلَعِ), shows whether r5e1's result holds without a vowel on the letter.
exercises.spec: Tadwīr, stop at the end of each ayah. إِنَّآ ghunnah and munfaṣil 4 · أَنزَلْنَـٰهُ ikhfāʾ · وَمَآ munfaṣil 4 · ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ muttaṣil 4 · خَيْرٌۭ مِّنْ idghām with ghunnah · مِّنْ أَلْفِ iẓhār · رَبِّهِم مِّن idghām shafawī with ghunnah · مِّن كُلِّ ikhfāʾ · qalqalah on the dāl of every ٱلْقَدْرِ and on مَطْلَعِ · ٱلْفَجْرِ heavy rāʾ at the stop.

مَطْلَعِ — make the sākin ṭāʾ light, like tāʾ: 'matlaʿ'.

وَٱلسَّمَآءِ — make the sīn heavy, like ṣād.
ٱلطَّارِقُ — make the ṭā' light, like tā'.
ٱلثَّاقِبُ — say the thā' as sīn.

إِنَّ — drop the ghunnah: a short plain nūn, no nasal hold.
هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ — both madds at 2 counts.
